sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not let the simple-support branch pass merely because continuity, ice-area termination, or rotational-restraint demonstration data are absent. Use the supplied nltl:demonstratedRotationalRestraint on the relevant nltl:memberSupport: the rotational-restraint fixed-support alternative must require demonstratedRotationalRestraint true together with significantRotationalRestraintEvidence, while the simple-support alternative must require explicit false values for connectionBracketPresent and demonstratedRotationalRestraint and explicit false values for continuousThroughSupport and terminatesWithinIceStrengthenedArea. Replace the absence-based sh:not logic accordingly; the required canonical term is already supplied, so no matcher is needed.
